steps.title: Talk to Crundi
steps.body: Ask Crundi about your projects out loud: usage, services, the kanban board, notes, files. It answers in a calm British voice, briefly, with the detail on screen. On the phone hold the side key or open Crundi Voice; on the web, open /voice. It only reads for now, and runs on your own Claude and Deepgram keys with a monthly limit.

keys.text: the voice page and its settings
on the phone, with Crundi as the assistant

steps.title: API spend beside your usage
steps.body: The usage window now shows what the voice assistant has spent on the Claude API this month, against its limit, with Claude and Deepgram apart. It is billed separately from your subscription, so it gets its own bar.

steps.title: Claude can touch a page
steps.body: Claude can tap, long-press, swipe and pinch a page the way a finger does, and sees what took each gesture: an overlay in the way, a script that stopped the scroll. So it can test and fix how a site feels on a phone.
